prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Animated Playthrough Redesign: Redesign the story screen into a stage layout featuring an animated mascot preview and playful story audio snippet before choosing a path. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514 seconds, indicating potential user hesitation at the very start of onboarding.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Accessory Starter Customizer Screen: Insert a new companion customization screen into the adoption sub-flow allowing users to pick a starter collar or accessory. (why: Adoption is the biggest bottleneck with only 60.9% completion; increasing investment and ownership boosts adoption conversion.)
2: [home, wait_info] Asset Generation Sound and Visual Checklist: Update the waiting screen with a visual checklist showing system asset rendering and desktop environment initialization. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing up or app failing to launch, and home step dropoff is 18.7%.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Engine Initialization Audio Cue: Play an audio chime and enable desktop system tray readiness notification on the waiting screen when asset loading completes. (why: Users wait a median of 201s during the home step; audio cues reduce dropped sessions while app renders in background.)
4: [finish, layout] Home Intro Card Layout with Companion Welcome: Rebuild home_intro using card layout with a prominent mascot avatar welcoming the pet onto the screen. (why: Finish completion rate is only 64.8% with mean time over 5800s, showing users abandon before completing final step.)
5: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Interactive Controls Screen: Add a dedicated interactive control tutorial screen right after home intro explaining drag, click, and tray hide actions. (why: Support theme specifically mentions user confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.)

scores.note: Animated redesign adds polish but may increase friction on a step without support complaints.
Targets the biggest funnel dropoff (adoption), though adding a new screen increases step count.
Directly backed by 3 support tickets and funnel wait time; progress indicators reduce loading abandonment.
Low cost fix addressing long 201s median wait time by notifying users in background.
Improves final step visuals where 35.2% drop off, though lacks specific support mail evidence.
Solves major support pain point regarding control confusion on a high-dropoff final step.
